kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انحرفت (form VII)
# اِنْحَرَفْتُ (inḥaraftu) /in.ħa.raf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْحَرَفَ (inḥarafa)
# اِنْحَرَفْتَ (inḥarafta) /in.ħa.raf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْحَرَفَ (inḥarafa)
# اِنْحَرَفْتِ (inḥarafti) /in.ħa.raf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْحَرَفَ (inḥarafa)
# اِنْحَرَفَتْ (inḥarafat) /in.ħa.ra.fat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
